newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to trade European-style semiconductor index.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to trade European-style semiconductor index.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said it would begin trading options on a European exercise-style version of its semiconductor index .SOXX on February 24.
The new index .SXE would have the same component issues and contract specifications as the American-style index, the exchange said.

The difference is in exercise. With a European-style exercise, investors can only exercise at expiration. American-style allows exercise any time up to expiration. ((-Derivatives desk 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
